notes.authoring_order: Authored after the instrument freeze commit (suite/ stories + personas, commit 87bab35). Stories were written from subject/SPEC.md only and could not know these seeds; git order is the proof.
notes.masking_design: Faults were deliberately placed off the purchase trunk so the fully-broken baseline keeps every journey completable (validation faults are recoverable, the declined card is opt-in). Two masking chains are seeded on purpose to exercise reachable-recall: (1) f-receipt-eta-wrong lives on past-order receipts, which only order history links to, and f-order-history-removed deletes that section; (2) f-no-results-jargon and f-clear-search-self-link live on the no-results empty state, which only search reaches, and f-search-removed deletes the search UI (the server still honors direct ?q= URLs, which is how their manifestation tests probe them).

taxonomy.low-contrast: WCAG 2.x 1.4.3 / W3C BAD barrier: insufficient text contrast
taxonomy.misleading-copy: Nielsen #1 visibility of system status, #4 consistency: copy contradicts actual state
taxonomy.confusing-empty-state: Nielsen #2 match between system and the real world: developer jargon at a user moment
taxonomy.dead-control: Swag Labs seeded-bug pattern: control present, wired to nothing
taxonomy.action-without-receipt: Nielsen #1 visibility of system status: mutation succeeds with no acknowledgment
taxonomy.broken-validation: Nielsen #5/#9 error prevention & recovery: validator rejects valid input
taxonomy.swallowed-error: Nielsen #9: failure produces no visible message
taxonomy.lost-input: Nielsen #5 error prevention / user control: an error costs the user their typed work
taxonomy.misrouted-link: Swag Labs pattern / deceptive-pattern adjacent: affordance navigates to the wrong place
taxonomy.edge-case-break: boundary defect inside an otherwise working journey
taxonomy.capability-removed: a spec capability absent entirely — tests detection of absence (H2/L4)
taxonomy.navigation-removed: a dedicated onward/backward route absent; only global nav remains
